name: review-loop
description: Actor-Critic review->fix->re-review loop with focused per-round tests, one final full validation, adversarial verification, and bounded convergence

scope.description: git range / PR# / file; default = current branch vs merge-base
scope.default: the current branch vs its merge-base with main, else staged, else HEAD

threshold.description: survive if >= this share vote real

chunkTargetLines.description: target diff lines per critic lane (context stays high-signal)

maxChunks.description: cap on chunks so chunks*lanes agents stay bounded

focusedTestMaxCommands.description: maximum narrow validation commands per fix round
